top_upcoming_lead: The closest dates first. Search every competition on the calendar.
top_highlights_lead: Leaping, spinning the apparatus, and moving as five on the floor. Three points will change how you watch.
top_highlight_tumbling_summary: Push off the floor and fly
top_highlight_tumbling_body: A run-up leads into somersault after somersault. All five taking off at once is the best moment to watch.
top_highlight_apparatus_body: Individual gymnasts work with four apparatus. They throw and catch, blending the apparatus into the body's movement. A drop means a deduction.
top_highlight_group_summary: Five gymnasts, two and a half minutes in sync
top_highlight_group_body: In the group event, five gymnasts move as one. Handstands, partner work and changing formations are all built to the music.
top_services_title: We offer coaching, music editing and apparatus decoration
top_services_description: We work directly with gymnasts and coaches. Feel free to start with just a question.
top_service_coaching_body_1: We build a routine from scratch,
top_service_coaching_body_5: or in person at your venue.
top_service_background_music_body_1: We cut the music to the competition time
top_service_background_music_body_2: and shape it to fit your routine.
top_service_decorating_apparatus_body_3: You can bring your own apparatus.
top_features_lead: Find a competition, learn the rules, try judging, watch routines.
top_feature_calendar_body: Every competition in Japan, listed year by year, with dates, venues and whether it is streamed.
top_feature_rules_body: The rules of men's rhythmic gymnastics, explained so newcomers can follow them — from how scoring works to the rules for each apparatus.
top_feature_judge_body: Score a routine on the same sheet the judges use. It changes how you watch.
top_feature_oshimitsu_body: Search routine videos by gymnast, team or apparatus, and watch your favourite gymnast all in one go.
top_numbers_source: Every competition we list is checked against the organizer's announcement and the official guidelines. If you spot a mistake, let us know and we will fix it.
top_team_lead: A team of five, just like in the group event. Each has a different strength, so the guide changes from page to page. LINE stickers are on the way, too.
top_contact_body_1: Questions about music editing or apparatus decoration, corrections to competition data, interview and workshop requests — all welcome.
top_contact_body_strong: A message on Instagram reaches us fastest.
top_contact_body_2: A reply may take a few days.
top_contact_instagram_description: Day-to-day posts. The fastest way to reach us
top_contact_operator: Run by the Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics Internationalization Project (Takumi Shimizu) / Active since 2022
top_jsonld_organization_description: A site bringing together competition information, explanations of the rules, routine videos, and orders for music editing and apparatus decoration in men's rhythmic gymnastics. It is run as part of an effort to spread this Japanese-born sport around the world.
